headline: Brandefense DRPS joins the catalog; EWS Online Powershell v3 gains transport rule commands
summary_md:
- **Brandefense Digital Risk Protection Services 1.0.0** is a new partner pack: a threat intelligence integration with two incident types, eleven incident fields, a classifier and a mapper.
- **EWS Extension Online Powershell v3** added `ews-mail-flow-rule-create` and `ews-mail-flow-rule-update`, and pinned its EXO Docker version around a Microsoft bug.
- **Arista Switch** fixed ACL modeling for `%ACL-6-IPACCESS` events that carry no interface token, which had been shifting every field one position.
- Fixes elsewhere: CrowdStrike Falcon ODS/OFP mirroring, Magnet Automate's API base path, the generic account enrichment playbook, and a HealthCheck script crash.
- A quiet day otherwise — eight packs, no removals.

highlights.title: Brandefense Digital Risk Protection Services is a new partner pack
highlights.detail: A Brandefense-supported threat intelligence integration (min server 6.10.0) shipping Brandefense Incident and Brandefense Intelligence incident types, eleven incident fields, two layouts, a classifier and an incoming mapper, published to xsoar, marketplacev2 and platform.

highlights.title: Arista ACL events without an interface were parsed one field out of place
highlights.detail: The rule split the log into a positional `acl_tuple`, so an `%ACL-6-IPACCESS` message missing the interface token pushed the action into the interface slot; named regex extractions now supply `acl_name`, action, protocol and interface whether or not the interface is present.

highlights.title: Exchange Online can now create and modify mail flow rules
highlights.detail: `ews-mail-flow-rule-create` and `ews-mail-flow-rule-update` add transport rule management to EWS Extension Online Powershell v3.

highlights.title: CrowdStrike ODS and OFP detections were mirrored in as generic endpoint detections
highlights.detail: Detections with `product=epp` were classified as Endpoint Detection incidents during incoming mirroring rather than as On-Demand Scan or OFP detections.

highlights.title: Magnet Automate Beta was calling the wrong endpoints entirely
highlights.detail: Requests omitted the `/api/v0` base path, five commands sent no request body, and `mf-automate-workflow-run-cancel` posted to an incorrect endpoint.

items.Packs/BrandefenseDRPS: New partner pack (Brandefense, 1.0.0): digital risk protection, external attack surface and threat intelligence, with IP and domain reputation commands and incident fetching.
items.Packs/AristaSwitch: 1.0.9: ACL modeling handles %ACL-6-IPACCESS events with no interface token, so action, protocol and interface map correctly either way.
items.Packs/MicrosoftExchangeOnline: 1.10.7 added ews-mail-flow-rule-create and ews-mail-flow-rule-update; 1.10.6 pinned the pwsh-exchangev3 image over a Microsoft bug causing GetResponseHeader failures.
items.Packs/CrowdStrikeFalcon: 2.12.6: ODS and OFP detections with product=epp are no longer misclassified as generic Endpoint Detection incidents during incoming mirroring.
items.Packs/MagnetForensics: 1.0.1: restored the /api/v0 base path, added missing request bodies on five commands, and corrected the workflow-run-cancel endpoint.
items.Packs/RubrikPolaris: 1.9.2: Rubrik Object Location extended to the Rubrik Radar incident type, surfaced on the Radar layout and populated with the full object path by the context analysis playbook.
items.Packs/CommonPlaybooks: 2.8.7: Account Enrichment - Generic v2.1 no longer passes a placeholder "N/A" or empty username to enrichment commands.
items.Packs/HealthCheck: 3.1.4: HealthCheckIncidentTypes no longer fails with KeyError: 0, and gains its first test file.
